title: Product Profile and onboarding — 11 deployed BOLT outcomes
description: INERT DRAFT; owner requested creation after review. 11 BOLTs/38 stories; $2,000 shared budget, concurrency 8. Eleven human BOLT evidence reviews plus initial flow approval; no readiness/release/final gates. Agents run UI/CLI/API checks; reviewer reruns optional. Before activation qualify machine evidence, automatic release handoff, dev authority and operations bindings. See automatic-deployment.md. Registration authorizes no execution.
